description: Priests distinctly boost conversion and consolidation through real preaching. Receptive unaffiliated citizens recruit faster; weak foreign devotion (under 40) can gradually erode and switch under sustained Priest contact. Stable 40+ rival affiliation remains protected.

semantics.childUpbringing: Repeated household contact creates own religious affiliation. Two 80+ parents can gradually nurture children up to Devotion 55, but never inherit Zealot/Devout bands outright.
semantics.preaching: Priesthood is an independent, measurable social multiplier. Recent local Priest preaching adds a separate 24% weekly baseline recruitment opportunity (scaled by receptivity), over ordinary family/social exposure, and an additional 1.8× consolidation rate. Disabled Priest ablations retain direct prayer and ordinary social spread.
semantics.devotion: Priest interactions alone cannot displace an established 40+ rival believer. Low-devotion foreign followers gradually doubt their old affiliation in bounded steps under real local Priest preaching, and may freely choose the new religion once below 20; no forced blanket conversion and no competing AI God simulation yet.
semantics.migration: Faith follows actual people and households; exchange is abstract nearby social contact, not teleportation or divine broadcast.
semantics.reproducibility: Seven-day low-rate pulses use a separate seeded religion PRNG, preserving economic PRNG inputs.
semantics.competition: The first-pass low-devotion foreign affiliation path models a rival's personal state only; complete rival God power/Temple/AI and reciprocal missionary pressure remain deferred.
